QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] Darkness Investigation
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the #o9602659# in #m693007032# and gather any evidence of the darkness in Helia.
QuestInfo.2: While investigating the darkness with #p9201716#, you were joined by #p9201717#, who happened to be in Duo. #p9201717# promised to tell you more about Helia's past, when a similar darkness once threatened to extinguish all light.
